title: Your assistant on WhatsApp, with their accounts
summary: An assistant that answers your customers on your own WhatsApp number, by text or voice, from what your business knows.
description: When a customer writes to your WhatsApp number, your assistant answers them in their language (English, Pidgin, Yoruba, Hausa or Igbo) from your approved sources and the conversation so far, with every reply checked before it is sent. A voice note is heard and answered by voice. New customers are told they are talking to an assistant and can write PERSON for a person or STOP to stop; too many messages, and kinds of message it does not read, get a polite fixed answer. When it is unsure, or cannot answer, the customer is told someone will get back to them and you are told. You can answer only the customers on your list. Try it on Conversations with Talk to it here before customers do. It also tells each customer their own balance, recent transactions and what they owe, read for the person writing (by their number or chat in your customers' accounts table) and never anyone else; nothing is paid or changed.

params.name: conn
params.title: WhatsApp connection
params.description: Your business's own WhatsApp number, connected to Taskiem.

params.name: business_name
params.title: Business name
params.description: How your assistant names your business to customers.

params.name: about
params.title: About your business
params.description: A few lines your assistant always keeps in mind: what you sell, where you are, your opening hours, and how you like to speak to customers. Prices and offers belong in your approved sources, where they are checked.
params.example: We cook and deliver Nigerian meals in Lekki and Ajah, every day from 9am to 9pm. Be warm and brief.

params.name: reply_by_voice
params.title: Answer a voice note with a voice note
params.description: When a customer sends a voice note, your assistant answers by speaking. Otherwise it writes.

params.name: gather_seconds
params.title: Wait for more messages (seconds)
params.description: A customer who sends several short messages in a row gets one answer to all of them: your assistant waits this long after each message for another.

params.name: only_listed
params.title: Only answer customers on your list
params.description: Your assistant answers only the customers in your allowed customers table, and says nothing to anyone else. Leave it off to answer everyone.

params.name: allowed_table
params.title: Allowed customers table
params.description: The customers your assistant may answer, when you choose to answer only them. Taskiem makes it for you if it does not exist.

params.name: conversations_table
params.title: Conversations table
params.description: Where what was said is kept, so your assistant remembers the conversation. Taskiem makes it for you if it does not exist.

params.name: accounts_table
params.title: Customers' accounts table
params.description: Who each customer is: their number or chat, and their wallet or account at your payments service. Taskiem makes it for you if it does not exist.

params.name: rail_connection
params.title: Your payments service
params.description: Where your customers' wallets or accounts are: iswallet, or bank accounts linked through Mono. Chosen once here, so connecting another payments service later changes nothing.
